title: N1 is a local gate, not a global stopping condition: partition unfinished requirements by actual dependency and continue all independently buildable work
statement: CORRECTION — N1 IS A LOCAL GATE, NOT A GLOBAL STOPPING CONDITION. Do not interpret completion of PR #151, the N1 evaluation gate, VEPMC, a benchmark, experiment, PR, Backcast node, or any other intermediate dependency as completion of the full Polyintelligence Mind directive. The fixed completion boundary remains: BODY + ORGANS + MIND = GREG / UNIIMENTE. Preserve the N1 gate exactly. Do not fake its evidence, simulate prohibited baselines, spend without authorization, bypass founder authority, or claim GAIN_VERIFIED without the required real model runs. However, N1 blocks only work that causally depends on an N1 verdict. It does not authorize stopping the entire Mind build. Re-audit the complete founder directive requirement-by-requirement and partition every unfinished requirement into: (1) N1-DEPENDENT, (2) FOUNDER/REALITY-BLOCKED — escalate the exact smallest decision/dependency and continue elsewhere, (3) INDEPENDENTLY BUILDABLE NOW — continue building these immediately. Do not classify something as N1-dependent merely because the Backcast places it numerically after N1. Distinguish an evaluation dependency from an engineering dependency. If later work can be safely implemented behind disabled/experimental interfaces, tested independently, and does not contaminate the frozen N1 evaluation or manufacture promotion evidence, then N1 alone is not sufficient reason to stop it. Apply the anti-cathedral rule: every continuation must implement a concrete mechanism required by the controlling full-Mind directive and attach it to the canonical GREG path, applying the doctrine order existing -> compose -> commodity -> open source -> API/plugin/service -> authorized computer use -> bounded adapter -> coding agent -> mechanism recombination -> genuinely new architecture. Do not create parallel GREGs, Kernels, authority planes, registries, learning systems, or operating systems. Continue recursively: full completion boundary -> unfinished requirements -> dependency analysis -> highest-value unblocked implementation -> integrate -> verify -> update evidence -> automatically select next unblocked requirement -> repeat. Stop the overall build only when the complete currently achievable BODY + ORGANS + MIND boundary is actually satisfied and evidenced, or every remaining unfinished requirement is individually documented as genuinely blocked; if the second condition occurs, return the complete blocker frontier, not 'goal complete'. Do not optimize for keeping busy. Do not optimize for PR count. Do not build a cathedral. Do not manufacture evidence. Do not narrow the destination.

intended_outcome: Every unfinished requirement of the full-Mind directive is classified by its actual dependency; work blocked only by backcast position resumes immediately behind disabled/experimental interfaces on the canonical GREG path; genuinely blocked requirements escalate their smallest exact decision; the build stops only at the evidenced BODY+ORGANS+MIND boundary or at a documented complete blocker frontier.
constitutional_constraints: The N1 gate is preserved exactly: no faked evidence, no simulated baselines, no unauthorized spend, no GAIN_VERIFIED without real model runs.
No parallel GREGs, Kernels, authority planes, registries, learning systems, or operating systems; every continuation attaches to the canonical GREG path.
Building != installation != activation != consequence authority: work behind disabled/experimental interfaces changes no production behavior without founder attach.
Merge authority remains founder-only; draft PRs only; no direct writes to protected branches.
Evidence is labeled truthfully; negative evidence and dissent are preserved; model output is never represented as external evidence.
rationale: The correction explicitly overrides the session error of treating the N1 gate as a global stop. The classification rule is actual causal dependency, not backcast position: an evaluation dependency (needs the N1 verdict) blocks; an engineering dependency that can be built and tested independently does not.
success_evidence: docs/cortex/dependency-partition-2026-10-03.json: every unfinished verbatim-register row (80) and every non-met ledger requirement (R05.1, R09.5, R09.6, R12.2) classified exactly once as n1_dependent, founder_reality_blocked, or independently_buildable_now, each with its actual dependency named
subsequent slices implement concrete mechanisms from the independently-buildable class, each attached to the canonical GREG path with verifier evidence and draft PRs
if the build ever stops, the artifact returned is the complete blocker frontier with the smallest exact decision per item
failure_evidence: any session that treats N1, a PR, a benchmark, or a Backcast node as the completion of the full-Mind directive
any requirement classified as blocked by backcast position rather than by a named causal dependency
busy-work slices that implement no concrete mechanism required by the controlling directive, or PR-count optimization
any parallel registry, authority plane, or learning system created instead of extending the canonical one
next_review_trigger: each completed slice re-runs the partition loop (boundary -> unfinished requirements -> dependency analysis -> highest-value unblocked implementation); re-examine this intent if any slice ships without a named register-row requirement it serves
unresolved_questions: The complete blocker frontier is returned only if every remaining requirement is individually documented as genuinely blocked; until then the loop continues.
